wins.text: Worldwide Q3 sales of $22.5B, up 6.3% operationally; Innovative Medicine sales of $14.6B (second consecutive quarter above $14B) with 11 brands delivering double-digit growth
DARZALEX became first J&J product to reach $3B in sales in a single quarter, growing 22.9% YoY driven by 4-point share gains across all lines of therapy
CARVYKTI achieved $286M in sales with 87.6% YoY growth and 53.2% sequential growth, driven by capacity expansion, share gains and CARTITUDE-4 approval in 2L+ setting
Free cash flow year-to-date of ~$14B vs. ~$12B in prior year; adjusted operational EPS guidance raised for the third consecutive quarter with underlying EPS growth of 9.2% ex-M&A

5 major U.S. and EC approvals in Q3 including RYBREVANT+LAZCLUZE for first-line EGFR-mutated lung cancer and TREMFYA for active ulcerative colitis; OTTAVA robotic surgery IDE application submitted to FDA

risks.text: MedTech full-year 2024 adjusted operational sales growth guidance lowered to ~5% from ~6% due to persistent Asia Pacific/China headwinds from VBP, anticorruption campaign, Korea HCP strike, and Japan macro pressures
STELARA biosimilar entry anticipated in U.S. in January 2025 with significant LOE impact; HUMIRA erosion curve cited as proxy, and Part D redesign expected to create additional negative impact
Adjusted pretax operating margin declining ~200 bps in 2024 due to M&A-related acquired IP R&D expense ($1.25B for NM26); enterprise adjusted income before tax margin fell from 37.6% to 32.4%
$1.75B charge related to talc litigation settlement proposal impacted Q3 net earnings; confirmation hearing timeline uncertain though targeted for early 2025
IV saline shortage following Hurricane Helene flagged as a potential risk to elective surgical procedure volumes across MedTech portfolio in Q4

guidance_items.detail: Operational sales growth raised by $200M to 6.3%-6.8% range, midpoint $89.6B (6.6%); reported sales growth 5.1%-5.6%, midpoint $88.6B
Adjusted operational EPS raised $0.10 on underlying performance (total +$0.18 for year ex-M&A); reported adjusted EPS midpoint $9.93, essentially flat YoY after absorbing ~$0.92 of M&A dilution
MedTech full-year adjusted operational sales growth now expected ~5% vs. ~6% referenced last quarter due to China/Asia Pacific headwinds
2024 adjusted pretax operating margin now expected to decline ~200 bps; ex-M&A would have been +50 bps as originally guided
Net interest income projected $450M-$550M, up $150M vs. prior guidance; other income raised to $1.9B-$2.1B driven by one-time royalty rights monetization

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Hurricane-related IV saline shortage impact on elective surgical procedure volumes
Competitive PFA ablation catheter dynamics and J&J's EP market share trajectory ahead of VARIPULSE U.S. approval
Unfavorable patient mix / gross-to-net true-up dynamics specifically impacting U.S. TREMFYA and STELARA sales in Q3
